traffic_model.note: both sides write h1 (next block's residual) AND x2 (norm out)
traffic_model.ceiling_note: 1.25x is a DRAM-traffic ceiling; it is unattainable in any regime whose row has h1_fits_l2=true (32 MB L2 here vs 8 MB on C500)

fairness.flags: DO_ADD / DO_NORM constexpr select fused vs the two split kernels
fairness.tuning: two-stage (coarse 164 + a per-winner refine neighbourhood; exact counts in tune_tables[*].n_tried) per variant per regime; the unfused side additionally gets a joint chain re-tune over the top-4 x top-4 configs, which can only help it
